programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.sub-title: Lady Day: The Many Faces of Billie Holiday
programme.desc: Lady Day: The Many Faces of Billie Holiday tells us the story of one of jazz's greatest singers ever. Although Billie Holiday lived a life filled with tragedy, this documentary focuses more on her achievements as a singer and her exceptional ability to convey emotions through her voice, rather than going into detail about her drug and alcohol addictions and destructive relationships. Lady Day: The Many Faces of Billie Holiday features several brilliant performances of Billie Holiday. Colleagues such as Carmen McRae, Annie Ross, Mal Waldron, Buck Clayton, Harry “Sweets” Edison, and Milt Gabler offer their first-hand perspectives.

programme.title: Mel Lewis, James Powell, William Powell & Glenn Drewes
programme.sub-title: The Mel Lewis Orchestra live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Mel Lewis Orchestra was arguably the most influential big band since the swing era. They were an unusual band, creating new styles, succeeding in an era when big bands were unpopular and remaining integrated during racially tense periods.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Anita Oday, Göran Engdahl, Roman Dylag & John Poole
programme.desc: Anita O'Day boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O'Day's horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.) This show is a fitting testimony to one of jazz music's true originals and shows unequivocally why she is ranked in the top tier of vocalists along with Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Lalah Hathaway
programme.desc: Winner of five Grammys in four consecutive years, including the Grammy for best R&B album in 2017, Lalah Hathaway is a force impossible to ignore. The American artist has shared the scene with Prince, Snoop Dogg, Stevie Wonder, Anita Baker, Mary J. Blige, Frank Ocean and many others, an irrefutable proof of her keen musical sense and enormous talent. With a 26-year career, Hathaway is still highly sought after by the biggest names in music. See her transform the 2018 Sing Jazz festival scene into a real R&B club, where she flaunts her voice and stage presence out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Keith Jarrett
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano. Known as the Standards Trio, they put on an enthralling performance that shows these master musicians at their best.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.sub-title: Josh Evans - Ballad Of Ernie Washington
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Tim Hagans, Greg Osby, Javon Jackson & Kevin Hays
programme.sub-title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: Blue Note All Stars
programme.desc: Playing together for the first time, this concert features the "young lions" of the late 1990s, the cream of contemporary jazz musicians. As a team of individualists, they mix contemporary and traditional jazz in a whole new way, playing well-known standards as well as their own compositions. With Tim Hagans on trumpet, Greg Osby on alto sax, Javon Jackson on tenor sax, Kevin Hays on piano, Esslet Esslet on double bass, and Bill Stewart on drums, this is an amazing line up. Over the years, they have each established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers, and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería & José Areán
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love. The symphony, built on the composer's personal anguish and existential explorations, is characterized by its deep emotional range, intricate orchestration, and epic scale, culminating in a powerful affirmation of human connection in the face of mortality. Deryck Cook completed a version of the work with the help of materials provided by Mahler's widow.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Ballets de Monte Carlo
programme.desc: 'La Belle' (The Sleeping Beauty) is a three-act ballet by award-winning French choreographer Jean-Christophe Maillot. In 1993, Maillot became artistic director of the Ballets de Monte-Carlo, creating over 30 ballets for the company, including 'Romeo and Juliet' (1996), 'Scheherazade' (2009), and 'Opus 50' (2011). Based on Charles Perrault's famous fairy tale, Maillot staged this unconventional and unique version of 'La Belle', which explores the darker side of Perrault's story. The incredible choreography is set to the score of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky, performed by the Monte-Carlo Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of Nicolas Brochot. Besides the performers of the Ballets de Monte-Carlo, the production features star dancers of the Bolshoi Ballet: Semyon Chudin (Prince) and Olga Smirnova (La Belle). This performance was recorded at the Salle des Princes of the Grimaldi Forum in Monaco, in December 2016.

programme.title: Kylie Minogue
programme.desc: Two hours of classic Kylie, capturing the energy, grandeur and extravagance of the massively acclaimed Aphrodite: Les Folies tour. Filmed at Kylie's triumphant O2 Arena show in London, this concert film was produced using a lavishly hi-tech multi-camera shoot affording the viewer a spectacular experience from start to finish. The 2-hour show proved to be one of the most elaborate and extravagant productions ever staged by a pop performer, a multi-million dollar visual and musical feast, that delighted critics and fans alike wherever it played. Now Kylie's fans can re-live the experience with this amazing 2-hour document, which includes all of her best-known modern hits- "Can t Get You Out Of My Head", "Spinning Around"- as well as her four Billboard Club smashes from 2010's acclaimed "Aphrodite" album including "All The Lovers" and "Get Outta My Way".

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks

programme.title: A Horse for Spring
programme.desc: Riley Adams's hopes of becoming a top-notch dancer are dashed after a terrible accident. An unexpected act of kindness from an unlikely source helps Riley learn about the power of faith, friendship, and love in this heartwarming story. Also known as Healed by Grace.

programme.title: A Sister's Obsession
programme.desc: Kendra's life couldn't be more perfect – she has a loving husband, supportive best friend, and a blossoming career… and she was just awarded the title of Educator of the Year. But when Kendra stands up to deliver a speech at the awards banquet held in her honour, her life quickly starts to unravel.

programme.title: Killer App
programme.desc: A young hacker creates an "antisocial" networking app that matches enemies instead of friends. When her enemies start turning up dead, she must uncover who or what is behind it before it's too late

programme.title: The Assassination Bureau
programme.desc: A female journalist commissions the assassination of the chairman of an organization of assassins.

programme.title: Of Mice and Men

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: When a wisecracking black hustler from South Central L.A. finds himself transported back to medieval England, he leads the overthrow of an evil king and wins the heart of a proto feminist woman.

programme.title: Zookeeper (2011)
programme.desc: The animals at one particular zoo decide to break their code of silence in order to help their lovable zookeeper gain the attention of one particular woman.

programme.title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
programme.desc: The south of France. Two rival con men -- one is suave and sophisticated, the other is a third-rate American hustler -- make a wager.

programme.title: 3 Days to Kill
programme.desc: A dying CIA agent is offered an experimental drug that could save his life in exchange for one last assignment

programme.title: The Cold Light of Day
programme.desc: After his family is kidnapped, a young Wall Street trader is confronted by the people responsible.

programme.title: Man on a Ledge
programme.desc: A police psychologist works to talk down an ex-con who is threatening to jump from a Manhattan hotel rooftop.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Partnered with a sly competitor, a high schooler plays an online game of dare that takes a sinister turn.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Cold Brook
programme.desc: One fateful evening, after working late hours at the museum, two maintenance workers see a man standing silently near a Civil War exhibit. Despite chasing him away, each night he returns. Soon Ted and George learn that no one else can see the mysterious figure dressed in centuries-old clothing his name is Gil Le Doux and he's searching for a way home.

programme.title: It's a Boy Girl Thing
programme.desc: It's A Boy Girl Thing is a brilliantly funny romantic comedy about next-door neighbours who live worlds apart. Woody Deane (Zegers) and Nell Bedworth (Armstrong) are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies. In their switched identities, each sets out to destroy the other's high school reputation. When they start to succeed they get more than they bargained for. Sometimes falling in love can be an out of body experience.

programme.title: Mythica: The Necromancer
programme.desc: A non-stop action fantasy that will transport you into a world of sorcerers, trolls and witches. When her most loyal friend is taken hostage by the cruel master of the Thieves Guild, Marek embarks on a corrupt mission. But when the mission leads into the clutches of Szorlok - their greatest enemy - Marek must sacrifice her ambitions and perhaps her own soul to save her friends.

programme.title: Endings, Beginnings
programme.desc: Daphne (Woodley), a young woman recovering from a break-up is at a turning point in her life and embarks on a few months of self-introspection. But when she meets friends Jack (Dornan) and Frank (Stan) at a party, everything changes... Daphne becomes involved with both of them, starting a steamy and complicated love triangle.

programme.title: Ruth and Alex
programme.desc: Hollywood heavyweights Morgan Freeman (Driving Miss Daisy) and Diane Keaton (Manhattan) unite to redefine the term coming of age in this heart-warming story about life, love and real estate! When a couple opts to put their apartment on the market over one crazy weekend, they discover that finding a new place is not about winding down but starting a whole new adventure!

programme.title: Summoning
programme.desc: In 1930's Paris, American sisters and spiritual mediums Laura and Kate Barlow tour pre-war Europe, where curious spectators join them onstage for a hypnotic sance with the dead

programme.title: The Secret Scripture
programme.desc: Lady Rose (Vanessa Redgrave) is an elderly woman who has lived in a hospital for over 50 years. Despite her bleak surroundings there is a light in her eyes that cannot be extinguished. Dr. Stephen Grene (Eric Bana) is drawn to her, compelled to discover her past and help gain her freedom.

programme.title: Bee Season
programme.desc: Richard Gere stars in this gripping tale about a father obsessed with training his talented daughter for the National Spelling Bee.

programme.desc: (2022) Rom-com starring Malone Thomas. A hopeless romantic buys a book from a mysterious store, only to find its stories unfolding in real life. Will it depict her own love story?

programme.title: You Stupid Man

programme.title: Dashing Home For Christmas
programme.desc: Emily is trying to get home for Christmas and encounters one problem after another. She meets Simon, a fellow traveler, who helps her a few times and they eventually join together in an effort to get to Seattle.

programme.desc: A strong-willed but moody teenager Lizzy is sent to live on her grandmother's ranch after an incident at school gets her suspended. Although reticent at first, Lizzy finally starts to unwind with the help of a nameless pony whom she calls Hope. When Lizzy learns the unfortunate news that the ranch is about to be foreclosed she devises a plan that will not only save her grandmother's property but also help Hope in the process.

programme.title: Christmas At The Holly Hotel
programme.desc: Kathy, a food critic in New York City, returns home for Christmas at the request of her parents. There she meets a handsome police officer, which now complicates her situation.

programme.desc: When she left Utah as a young widow, Laura Trudeau left behind her father, her love of dance -- and an old heartbreak. Now, she must return home to spearhead the renovation of a derelict hotel, which must be restored in time for a Christmas Eve benefit dance performance. But Laura is shocked to learn that her old love, Ricardo Archuleta, the boy who jilted her for a professional dance career, is the star of the dance benefit. And when his dance partner Taylor walks out on the show for an out-of-town audition, Laura has to step in for her, reawakening her love of the dance, not to mention her old feelings for Ricardo -- a potent combination that has her head spinning.

programme.title: A Christmas of Wonders
programme.desc: Eliza, a writer for travel magazines and websites, has returned to her small hometown after an absence. Despite the passage of time, not much has changed in the town, and her family continues to participate in the same traditions. Through these activities, Eliza is reunited with Will, a former heartthrob, who helps her rediscover the significance of these family traditions.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.sub-title: Lady Day: The Many Faces of Billie Holiday
programme.desc: Lady Day: The Many Faces of Billie Holiday tells us the story of one of jazz's greatest singers ever. Although Billie Holiday lived a life filled with tragedy, this documentary focuses more on her achievements as a singer and her exceptional ability to convey emotions through her voice, rather than going into detail about her drug and alcohol addictions and destructive relationships. Lady Day: The Many Faces of Billie Holiday features several brilliant performances of Billie Holiday. Colleagues such as Carmen McRae, Annie Ross, Mal Waldron, Buck Clayton, Harry “Sweets” Edison, and Milt Gabler offer their first-hand perspectives.

programme.title: Mel Lewis, James Powell, William Powell & Glenn Drewes
programme.sub-title: The Mel Lewis Orchestra live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Mel Lewis Orchestra was arguably the most influential big band since the swing era. They were an unusual band, creating new styles, succeeding in an era when big bands were unpopular and remaining integrated during racially tense periods.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Anita Oday, Göran Engdahl, Roman Dylag & John Poole
programme.desc: Anita O'Day boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O'Day's horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.) This show is a fitting testimony to one of jazz music's true originals and shows unequivocally why she is ranked in the top tier of vocalists along with Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Lalah Hathaway
programme.desc: Winner of five Grammys in four consecutive years, including the Grammy for best R&B album in 2017, Lalah Hathaway is a force impossible to ignore. The American artist has shared the scene with Prince, Snoop Dogg, Stevie Wonder, Anita Baker, Mary J. Blige, Frank Ocean and many others, an irrefutable proof of her keen musical sense and enormous talent. With a 26-year career, Hathaway is still highly sought after by the biggest names in music. See her transform the 2018 Sing Jazz festival scene into a real R&B club, where she flaunts her voice and stage presence out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Keith Jarrett
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano. Known as the Standards Trio, they put on an enthralling performance that shows these master musicians at their best.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.sub-title: Josh Evans - Ballad Of Ernie Washington
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Tim Hagans, Greg Osby, Javon Jackson & Kevin Hays
programme.sub-title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: Blue Note All Stars
programme.desc: Playing together for the first time, this concert features the "young lions" of the late 1990s, the cream of contemporary jazz musicians. As a team of individualists, they mix contemporary and traditional jazz in a whole new way, playing well-known standards as well as their own compositions. With Tim Hagans on trumpet, Greg Osby on alto sax, Javon Jackson on tenor sax, Kevin Hays on piano, Esslet Esslet on double bass, and Bill Stewart on drums, this is an amazing line up. Over the years, they have each established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers, and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería & José Areán
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love. The symphony, built on the composer's personal anguish and existential explorations, is characterized by its deep emotional range, intricate orchestration, and epic scale, culminating in a powerful affirmation of human connection in the face of mortality. Deryck Cook completed a version of the work with the help of materials provided by Mahler's widow.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Ballets de Monte Carlo
programme.desc: 'La Belle' (The Sleeping Beauty) is a three-act ballet by award-winning French choreographer Jean-Christophe Maillot. In 1993, Maillot became artistic director of the Ballets de Monte-Carlo, creating over 30 ballets for the company, including 'Romeo and Juliet' (1996), 'Scheherazade' (2009), and 'Opus 50' (2011). Based on Charles Perrault's famous fairy tale, Maillot staged this unconventional and unique version of 'La Belle', which explores the darker side of Perrault's story. The incredible choreography is set to the score of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky, performed by the Monte-Carlo Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of Nicolas Brochot. Besides the performers of the Ballets de Monte-Carlo, the production features star dancers of the Bolshoi Ballet: Semyon Chudin (Prince) and Olga Smirnova (La Belle). This performance was recorded at the Salle des Princes of the Grimaldi Forum in Monaco, in December 2016.

programme.desc: Lenny Kravitz has been consolidated as one of the stars that has been in force for a long time, this has led him to appear all over the world and be part of the most popular festivals in the world. programme.title: Kylie Minogue
programme.desc: Two hours of classic Kylie, capturing the energy, grandeur and extravagance of the massively acclaimed Aphrodite: Les Folies tour. Filmed at Kylie's triumphant O2 Arena show in London, this concert film was produced using a lavishly hi-tech multi-camera shoot affording the viewer a spectacular experience from start to finish. The 2-hour show proved to be one of the most elaborate and extravagant productions ever staged by a pop performer, a multi-million dollar visual and musical feast, that delighted critics and fans alike wherever it played. Now Kylie's fans can re-live the experience with this amazing 2-hour document, which includes all of her best-known modern hits- "Can t Get You Out Of My Head", "Spinning Around"- as well as her four Billboard Club smashes from 2010's acclaimed "Aphrodite" album including "All The Lovers" and "Get Outta My Way".

programme.title: Kolya
programme.desc: Louka es un concertista de violoncelo y profesor de renombre en la Checoslovaquia ocupada por los soviéticos. Al perder su puesto en la orquesta, no le queda más remedio que tocar en los funerales para sobrevivir. Pero ha contraído muchas deudas y no puede saldarlas. Por eso, cuando el señor Broz, el enterrador, le sugiere que resuelva sus problemas económicos casándose con una joven rusa que quiere conseguir la nacionalidad checa, acepta. Ella se aprovecha de esta situación para emigrar con su amante a Alemania Occidental, dejando a su hijo de cinco años con su abuela. Pero cuando la abuela muere, Kolya deberá vivir con su padrastro.

programme.title: La bestia bajo el asfalto

programme.title: Los 400 golpes

La culpa y el miedo le llevan a una sucesión de mentiras que poco a poco van calando en su ánimo. Junto a René sueña con conocer el mar y trazan un plan para conseguirlo.

programme.title: La Gran Apuesta
programme.desc: Basada en la historia real de 4 desconocidos que vieron lo que rechazaron los grandes bancos y el gobierno: el derrumbamiento mundial de la economía.

programme.desc: Tras el terrible vertido de un petrolero, un congresista decidido a ir contra la empresa petrolera, se ve involucrado en un escándalo sexual.

programme.title: Invisibles

programme.title: Encontrando el Fin del Mundo
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su esposa y su hijo menor, Jorge, un músico desempleado, queda a cargo de su hijo mayor.

programme.title: La Marca Del Lobo
programme.desc: Una muchacha presenció el asesinato de su familia. La joven sobrevivió adentrándose en el bosque.

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Bob, un exitoso chef, rehace su vida en un restaurante rural. Allí volverá a creer en el amor.

programme.title: El Chico De La Burbuja De Plástico
programme.desc: Un niño que nace con una deficiencia en su sistema inmunológico

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos

programme.title: Chungking Express
programme.desc: Dos historias de amor en un popular barrio turístico de Hong Kong. La primera describe el encuentro entre un joven policía y una misteriosa mujer fatal traficante de drogas. La segunda entre un solitario agente de policía y la joven camarera del bar donde aquél suele comer.

programme.title: Zoe
programme.desc: Dos compañeros en un revolucionario laboratorio diseñan la tecnología que mejora y perfecciona relaciones románticas. Mientras su trabajo progresa, sus descubrimientos se hacen más profundos.

programme.title: Dulce como el amor
programme.desc: Jessie Dale es la tercera generación de panaderos y ama su pastelería más que a nada en el mundo. Unos desarrolladores amenazan con comprar el edificio y obligarla a irse, por lo que se ve en la obligación de hacer todo lo posible para salvar la panadería.

programme.title: Devuélveme mi suerte
programme.desc: Ashley (Lindsay Lohan) es muy afortunada, tiene muy buena suerte y siempre le ha salido todo bien. Pero un día, Ashley besa a Jake (Chris Pine), el joven con peor suerte de la ciudad, y sus papeles se intercambian...

programme.title: La ciudad de la alegría
programme.desc: Tras operar sin éxito a una niña para salvarle la vida, Max Lowe renuncia a su carrera médica. Una vez notificada su decisión a las autoridades del hospital norteamericano donde trabaja, Max viaja a Calcuta para buscarse a sí mismo.

programme.title: La venganza de Manon
programme.desc: Manon, la hija de Jean de Florette, ha crecido. Siendo todavía una niña, fue testigo presencial de la conspiración llevada a cabo por Papet y Ugolin, cuyas fatídicas consecuencias provocaron la muerte de su padre. Pero ha llegado la hora de la venganza y Manon decide desvelar a todo el pueblo secretos guardados desde hace demasiado tiempo

programme.title: Smart People (Gente inteligente)
programme.desc: Lawrence Wetherhold es un respetado profesor de literatura, pero en su vida privada no todo funciona tan bien. Viudo, con un hijo totalmente perturbado y una hija introvertida. Pero todo puede empeorar: se enamora de una de sus antiguas alumnas, la doctora Janet Hartigan, y su hermano se presenta en su casa por sorpresa, sin dinero y sin alojamiento.

programme.title: Housebound
programme.desc: Bajo arresto domiciliario en la casa donde creció, Kylie Bucknell encuentra su sentencia aún más insoportable ya que debe cumplirla con su madre Miriam, que está convencida de que la casa está encantada. Kylie piensa que las supersticiones de su madre son ridículas pero cuando comienza a escuchar susurros inquietantes y extraños ruidos durante la noche, se pregunta si ha heredado la vívida imaginación de su madre o si la casa está realmente habitada por un espíritu hostil.

programme.title: Ya te extraño
programme.desc: Amistad femenina enfrenta cáncer y embarazo.

programme.title: Un hombre llamado Ove
programme.desc: Viudo gruñón encuentra nueva razón para vivir.

programme.title: Todo Me Pasa A Mí
programme.desc: El regreso de un amigo de la India hace que un grupo de jóvenes se cuestione sus relaciones.

programme.title: Buffaloed
programme.desc: Joven entra en el mundo de la cobranza de deudas.

programme.title: Un hombre llamado Ove
programme.desc: Ove no es el típico vecino con el que apetece cruzarte en el barrio. Es un cascarrabias, un pesado que insiste hasta la exageración en mantener el orden y la disciplina, un casi sesentón solitario y resentido a quien el destino ha arrebatado demasiadas cosas.

programme.title: Una noche con mi exsuegro
programme.desc: Durante una escala en Los Ángeles, el Señor Gallo, un testarudo y siempre ocupado hombre de negocios, decide ir a darle una sorpresa a su hija Ginnie. Pero una vez llega a su casa, descubre que ella se ha marchado sin dar explicaciones.

programme.title: Devuélveme mi suerte
programme.desc: Ashley (Lindsay Lohan) es muy afortunada, tiene muy buena suerte y siempre le ha salido todo bien. Pero un día, Ashley besa a Jake (Chris Pine), el joven con peor suerte de la ciudad, y sus papeles se intercambian...

programme.title: En temporada baja
programme.desc: Sigue la supuesta camaradería formada por Alberto, "el crack", quien fue un exitoso representante de futbolistas que ahora vive en un camping a las afueras de Valencia, y Charly, un policía divorciado que duerme en el trabajo.

programme.title: Ligas Mayores
programme.desc: La nueva propietaria de los Indians de Cleveland forma un equipo deliberadamente desastroso para que pierdan y así poder trasladar al equipo. Sin embargo, cuando su plan sale a la luz, los jugadores comienzan a ganar solo para fastidiarla.

programme.title: Aventuras En La Casa Branca
programme.desc: Dos adolescentes despistados se ven involucrados sin darse cuenta en el escándalo del Watergate que provocó la caída del gobierno de Nixon.

programme.title: Rumores Y Mentiras
programme.desc: El guión, obra del dramaturgo Bert V. Royal, es una versión moderna y en clave estudiantil de “La letra escarlata”, la novela de Nathaniel Hawthorne. Narra la historia de una joven que decide fingir que lleva una vida promiscua, creyendo que así obtendrá algún tipo de beneficio. Sin embargo, las circunstancias se volverán en su contra.

programme.title: Una Novata en un Cuento de Hadas
programme.desc: La historia de Blancanieves se adapta a los tiempos modernos, con estudiantes de primero en una universidad con hermandades.

programme.title: El regreso de los cuatro magníficos
programme.desc: El guardabosques retirado de Texas, Nash Crawford, vuelve a montar su antiguo equipo de guardabosques de los viejos tiempos para luchar contra el crimen en su ciudad natal.

programme.title: El cuatrero errante
programme.desc: El hermano se enfrenta al hermano en esta historia de rancheros enfrentados en el viejo oeste.

programme.title: El grito en la sangre
programme.desc: En algún lugar del interior de la Argentina, la creencia popular sostiene que cuando un hombre muere a traición, éste debe ser vengado por su primogénito, para que esa alma descanse en paz.

programme.title: Pistoleros de Río Grande
programme.desc: Un vagabundo regresa a un pequeño pueblo para vengar el asesinato de su esposa e hija.

programme.title: Cazadores de tesoros
programme.desc: Un niño y su perro deben ir en busca de un legendario tesoro local para salvar la casa familiar de la ejecución hipotecaria.

programme.title: Quicksand
programme.desc: Un banquero adicto al trabajo viaja a Mónaco para investigar las actividades de una empresa y se encuentra culpado de un asesinato... y corriendo por su vida.

programme.title: La Última Noticia
programme.desc: Un locutor de radio peruano arriesga su vida para informar sobre los enfrentamientos entre la policía y la guerrilla.

programme.title: Angel de la noche
programme.desc: Cuando se trata de conquistar a una mujer, nada resulta más útil que su propio diario. Entre secretos y confesiones, un hombre descubre que el amor puede ser un juego peligroso si conoces demasiado bien los pensamientos de la otra persona.

programme.title: El regreso de Aladino
programme.desc: Después de liberar a Bagdad de las garras de su terrible visir, Aladin está aburrido en palacio. Todavía no ha decidido pedir matrimonio a la princesa. Pero un terrible dictador, Shah Zaman, se invita al Palacio y anuncia que ha venido a tomar la ciudad y casarse con la Princesa. Aladin no tiene más remedio que huir del Palacio. Intentará recuperar a su antiguo Genio y así, volver para liberar a la ciudad y salvar a su novia.

programme.title: Arthur 3: La guerra de los mundos
programme.desc: “Tercera y última entrega de la trilogía de Arthur y los Minimoys. Maltazard ha conseguido colarse en el mundo de los humanos. Su objetivo es sencillo: reclutar un ejército de gigantescos secuaces y dominar el universo. Arthur parece ser el único capaz de frustrar sus planes, pero primero tendrá que volver a su habitación... y recuperar su tamaño normal.” Aunque sigue atrapado en un diminuto cuerpo de minimoy, contará con la ayuda de Selenia y Betameche, y, sorprendentemente, también la de Darkos, el hijo de Maltazard, que afirma estar de su lado. A pie, en bici, en coche o incluso en una Harley Davidson, Arthur y sus amigos emplearán cualquier medio a su alcance para librar su batalla final contra Maltazard.

programme.title: Jake
programme.desc: Una pareja casada, Alex y Greg, tiene que afrontar un conflicto cuando descubre que su hijo prefiere a la Cenicienta en lugar de los G.I. Joe.

programme.title: El callejón
programme.desc: En una noche invernal, Rosa se ve obligada a hacer la colada en una lavandería situada en un oscuro y desierto callejón. Allí sufrirá el acoso de un asesino en serie que la someterá al sádico juego del ratón y el gato.

programme.title: Mi amigo Blue
programme.desc: Una icónica historia de amistad entre un muchacho y un perro único y desgarbado que se convertiría en una leyenda australiana.

programme.title: María (y los demás)
programme.desc: Desde que murió su madre, María ha cuidado de su padre y de sus hermanos. Responsable y controladora, siempre ha sido el pilar de la familia y se siente orgullosa de ello. Por eso, cuando su padre anuncia que se casa con Cachita, su simpática enfermera, María siente que su mundo se desmorona.

programme.title: Anita no pierde el tren
programme.desc: Anita ve como derriban el cine en el que trabaja como taquillera. A partir de ese día su vida cambia.

programme.title: La final
programme.desc: Tres amigos hinchas del Atlético Madrid y tres chicas seguidoras del Real Madrid: todos protagonizan una historia de amor la semana de la final de Champions. Aure y Andrea tienen una tensión sexual no resuelta desde la adolescencia, fruto de la casualidad, surge el reencuentro.

programme.title: El amor no es lo que era
programme.desc: Este film narra tres historias de amor urbanas. Álex y Lucía se encuentran, empiezan a conocerse y entre ellos surge un romance. Paz y Jorge ven impotentes cómo su relación se apaga sin saber qué hacer. Finalmente, Albert e Irene vuelven a verse tras varios decenios de separación.

programme.title: Seven Dorms of Death
programme.desc: Seven Dorms of Death tells the tale of a cursed stage play that is about to be performed at a New England college. Unfortunately for the director, the young cast, and anyone else unlucky enough to be involved with the production, someone has deadly plans for the play! Can a pair of homicide detectives and a student with psychic powers solve the mystery before it's too late'

programme.title: Billy The Kid Versus Dracula
programme.desc: Dracula travels to the American West, intent on making a beautiful ranch owner his next victim. Her fiance, outlaw Billy the Kid, finds out about it and rushes to save her.

programme.title: Las Escrituras de la Muerte
programme.desc: Shannon es la encargada de restaurar una mansion victoriana. Las renovaciones van perfectamente hasta que el jefe del banco local es encontrado muerto.

programme.title: La Rapina a Pineville
programme.desc: Un adolescente delle superiori si imbatte nelle conseguenze di una rapina in banca andata storta e si ritrova rinchiuso nella sua scuola cercando di mantenere in vita se stesso e il suo insegnante mentre uno dei rapinatori psicotici li dà la caccia.

programme.title: Asylum Seekers
programme.desc: A freewheeling demented comedy about the modern world, in which six people, fed up with the abuse they suffer in their normal lives, seek asylum ... as inmates of a mental institution. The only problem is, there's just one bed available.

programme.title: County Line
programme.desc: Cuando el mejor amigo del ex sheriff Alden Rockwell es tiroteado, éste se ofrece como investigador privado para averiguar la verdad tras el tiroteo y descubre una conspiración criminal entre dos condados.

programme.title: Planet Dune
programme.desc: Una tripulación en misión para salvar una base abandonada en un planeta desértico se convierte en mortal cuando son acechados y atacados por los principales depredadores del planeta: gusanos de arena gigantes.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Es el Blitz de Londres en 1940. Un anciano y enfermo Dr. John Watson cuenta a su enfermera la historia de su investigación más compleja con Sherlock Holmes, que ambos juraron que nunca se contaría al público ni se adaptaría a una de las famosas historias de Watson.

programme.title: Blood Lake
programme.desc: Después de devorar a la población de peces, miles de lampreas hambrientas comienzan a atacar a los ciudadanos de una tranquila ciudad lacustre, y la comunidad lucha por mantenerse con vida.

programme.title: Vanguard
programme.desc: La compañía de seguridad encubierta Vanguard es la última esperanza de supervivencia para un contable que es perseguido por la organización de mercenarios más mortífera del mundo.

programme.title: Santos y soldados: Objetivo Berlín
programme.desc: El 15 de agosto de 1944, el equipo de combate del regimiento de paracaidistas llega al sur de Francia en una misión para apoyar a las tropas aliadas en su camino a Berlín. En su misión de guerra se encuentran con un grupo de franceses que necesitan ayuda, poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la misión.

programme.title: Comando War Pigs
programme.desc: Al Capitán de la Segunda Guerra Mundial Jack Wosick, se le da la oportunidad de redimirse cuando se le designa para dirigir una unidad variopinta de soldados inadaptados conocidos como los “War Pigs”.

programme.title: Una amenaza en la sombra
programme.desc: Wes Rawlins es un cazarecompensas y hombre de pocas palabras. Queda devastado cuando su madre es asesinada por una pareja de forajidos.

programme.title: En Primera Línea
programme.desc: En 1968, un equipo en Vietnam enfrenta tensiones raciales, crisis morales y el peso de la guerra.

programme.title: Hombres Muertos
programme.desc: En el Oeste, dos hermanos buscan vengar a su padre, proteger a los apaches y recuperar sus tierras.

programme.title: El ataque del tiburón de seis cabezas
programme.desc: Una escapada romántica en una isla remota se vuelve una pesadilla cuando un tiburón de seis cabezas ataca.

programme.title: Mega Python vs. Gatoroid
programme.desc: Una especie de pitón gigante invade los Everglades.

programme.title: El Imaginario del Doctor Parnassus
programme.desc: El Doctor Parnassus posee el extraordinario don de guiar la imaginación de los demás, pero sobre él recae una oscura maldición secreta. Jugador empedernido, miles de años atrás hizo una apuesta con el demonio, Mr. Nick, con la que se ganó la inmortalidad. Siglos más tarde, al conocer a su amor verdadero, Dr. Parnassus hizo otro trato con el diablo, comerciando su inmortalidad por su juventud, con la condición de que cuando su hija alcanzara la edad de 16 años, pasará a ser propiedad de Mr. Nick.

programme.title: 21: Blackjack
programme.desc: Crónica de las andanzas de un grupo de jóvenes expertos en triunfar en los casinos. Ben Campbell, un tímido y brillante estudiante del prestigioso Instituto Tecnológico de Massachussets (MIT), recurre a los naipes para poder pagar la matrícula de la universidad.

programme.title: El desafío
programme.desc: Basada en las memorias escritas por Philippe Petit (Joseph Gordon-Levitt), un funambulista francés que, en 1974, guiado por su mentor Papa Rudy (Ben Kingsley), se propuso un reto nunca antes realizado: recorrer sobre un cable el espacio que separaba las Torres Gemelas de Nueva York.
